description: Fleet release-gating and cadence policy for RIPDPI profile and fleet rollouts. Defines daily, weekly, release/rotation, staging, production, and client-release gate sets, plus the no-ship and warn-only failure policy. This artifact is the machine-readable source of truth enforced by scripts/ci/check_fleet_release_gates.py. The release gate produces a short sanitized report; raw probe logs and live endpoints belong under ops/live-infra/, never here.

staging.description: Staging deploy gate set; must pass before a production deploy is allowed.

production.description: Production deploy gate set; every gate is a no-ship blocker for promoting a profile to a primary production path.

noShipPolicy.description: A FAIL on any no-ship condition demotes the profile or blocks the client release; it is never shipped as a primary path.

warnOnlyPolicy.description: A FAIL on a warn-only condition is reported as WARN: it does not block the release but is surfaced in the sanitized report so degraded paths are demoted rather than relied on as primary.

report.description: The release gate emits a short sanitized PASS/WARN/FAIL summary per gate set, never raw probe logs or live endpoints.
